text:
anya: quick q — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4321 touches /services/runtime/healthcheck and updates CODEOWNERS to add a new alias. who can approve this?
liam: looks like it modifies runtime health check + CODEOWNERS. per CODEOWNERS that dir is owned by @eng-runtime and @eng-platform. do we have someone from eng-runtime online?
sam: I can pick it up if it's just the healthcheck tweak. what's the change? snippet:```diff
- /services/runtime/healthcheck  @eng-runtime
+ /services/runtime/healthcheck  @eng-runtime @eng-platform
```
anya: thanks — mostly a small config change to reduce 5xx on warmup, plus adding @eng-platform to CODEOWNERS so platform can merge infra-rollouts. added unit test and a short integration test.
olivia: heads-up: adding @eng-platform as a codeowner is fine, but we should confirm legal/ops don't need to sign off. also we have an owner-rotation window this week. if eng-runtime is out, we route to the eng-platform fallback per the owner policy.
ci-bot: build #4321 — unit tests passed, integration queued. :large_orange_circle:
liam: if eng-runtime can't review within 2h, follow fallback: ping @eng-oncall and @eng-platform for approval. @sam, can you review within that window?
sam: yes I'll take a look in ~30m. if it's trivial I'll approve. if risky, will request second pair.
anya: timeline: would like to merge today for canary deployment this evening. if we hit blockers, happy to hold.
olivia: process note — add a one-line changelog in the PR and mark the rollout plan in the description (canary % + rollback steps). that makes it easier for platform to approve fast.
sam: saw the tests, small nit about a timeout constant. will open a 1-line suggestion. after that + CI green I can approve and merge. :+1:
anya: thanks all — I'll add the rollout section now. pinging @eng-oncall if runtime owners are offline. :bell:
eng-oncall: we got the ping, will stand by for merge window and watch canary metrics after deploy. :eyes:
